If an item could reach any issue through a country, actor, market or institution not listed above, add that channel here with a date. Also: cyberattacks on infrastructure or supply chains anywhere, and US government readiness programs, with or without an attributed attacker.

note: Causal channels per issue: ways outside events can change what factions want or can do. The daily task extends it when it meets a new channel.
